In what was a dramatic day full of action, the last two rounds of Fast classical decided the 4 players who will go through to the semifinals of the Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot 2026. Anish Giri topped the group to go through to the semifinals, while Magnus Carlsen had two more draws against Ian Nepomniachtchi to finish winless in the group stage. Check out all that happened in this video!
